4122  @Override
4123  public CompletableFuture<CacheEvictionStats> clearBlockCache(TableName tableName) {
4124    CompletableFuture<CacheEvictionStats> future = new CompletableFuture<>();
4125    addListener(getTableHRegionLocations(tableName), (locations, err) -> {
4126      if (err != null) {
4127        future.completeExceptionally(err);
4128        return;
4129      }
4130      Map<ServerName, List<RegionInfo>> regionInfoByServerName =
4131        locations.stream().filter(l -> l.getRegion() != null)
4132          .filter(l -> !l.getRegion().isOffline()).filter(l -> l.getServerName() != null)
4133          .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(l -> l.getServerName(),
4134            Collectors.mapping(l -> l.getRegion(), Collectors.toList())));
4135      List<CompletableFuture<CacheEvictionStats>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
4136      CacheEvictionStatsAggregator aggregator = new CacheEvictionStatsAggregator();
4137      for (Map.Entry<ServerName, List<RegionInfo>> entry : regionInfoByServerName.entrySet()) {
4138        futures
4139          .add(clearBlockCache(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()).whenComplete((stats, err2) -> {
4140            if (err2 != null) {
4141              future.completeExceptionally(unwrapCompletionException(err2));
4142            } else {
4143              aggregator.append(stats);
4144            }
4145          }));
4146      }
4147      addListener(CompletableFuture.allOf(futures.toArray(new CompletableFuture[futures.size()])),
4148        (ret, err3) -> {
4149          if (err3 != null) {
4150            future.completeExceptionally(unwrapCompletionException(err3));
4151          } else {
4152            future.complete(aggregator.sum());
4153          }
4154        });
4155    });
4156    return future;
4157  }

4159  @Override
4160  public CompletableFuture<Void> cloneTableSchema(TableName tableName, TableName newTableName,
4161    boolean preserveSplits) {
4162    CompletableFuture<Void> future = new CompletableFuture<>();
4163    addListener(tableExists(tableName), (exist, err) -> {
4164      if (err != null) {
4165        future.completeExceptionally(err);
4166        return;
4167      }
4168      if (!exist) {
4169        future.completeExceptionally(new TableNotFoundException(tableName));
4170        return;
4171      }
4172      addListener(tableExists(newTableName), (exist1, err1) -> {
4173        if (err1 != null) {
4174          future.completeExceptionally(err1);
4175          return;
4176        }
4177        if (exist1) {
4178          future.completeExceptionally(new TableExistsException(newTableName));
4179          return;
4180        }
4181        addListener(getDescriptor(tableName), (tableDesc, err2) -> {
4182          if (err2 != null) {
4183            future.completeExceptionally(err2);
4184            return;
4185          }
4186          TableDescriptor newTableDesc = TableDescriptorBuilder.copy(newTableName, tableDesc);
4187          if (preserveSplits) {
4188            addListener(getTableSplits(tableName), (splits, err3) -> {
4189              if (err3 != null) {
4190                future.completeExceptionally(err3);
4191              } else {
4192                addListener(
4193                  splits != null ? createTable(newTableDesc, splits) : createTable(newTableDesc),
4194                  (result, err4) -> {
4195                    if (err4 != null) {
4196                      future.completeExceptionally(err4);
4197                    } else {
4198                      future.complete(result);
4199                    }
4200                  });
4201              }
4202            });
4203          } else {
4204            addListener(createTable(newTableDesc), (result, err5) -> {
4205              if (err5 != null) {
4206                future.completeExceptionally(err5);
4207              } else {
4208                future.complete(result);
4209              }
4210            });
4211          }
4212        });
4213      });
4214    });
4215    return future;
4216  }

4428  private CompletableFuture<List<LogEntry>> getSlowLogResponses(
4429    final Map<String, Object> filterParams, final Set<ServerName> serverNames, final int limit,
4430    final String logType) {
4431    if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(serverNames)) {
4432      return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(Collections.emptyList());
4433    }
4434    return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> serverNames
4435      .stream().map((ServerName serverName) -> getSlowLogResponseFromServer(serverName,
4436        filterParams, limit, logType))
4437      .map(CompletableFuture::join).flatMap(List::stream).collect(Collectors.toList()));
4438  }

4444        RequestConverter.buildSlowLogResponseRequest(filterParams, limit, logType),
4445        AdminService.Interface::getLogEntries, ProtobufUtil::toSlowLogPayloads))
4446      .serverName(serverName).call();

4450  public CompletableFuture<List<Boolean>>

4468  private static <T> CompletableFuture<List<T>>
4469    convertToFutureOfList(List<CompletableFuture<T>> futures) {
4470    CompletableFuture<Void> allDoneFuture =
4471      CompletableFuture.allOf(futures.toArray(new CompletableFuture[0]));
4472    return allDoneFuture
4473      .thenApply(v -> futures.stream().map(CompletableFuture::join).collect(Collectors.toList()));
4474  }

4525  @Override
4526  public CompletableFuture<Void> setRSGroup(Set<TableName> tables, String groupName) {
4527    CompletableFuture<Void> future = new CompletableFuture<>();
4528    for (TableName tableName : tables) {
4529      addListener(tableExists(tableName), (exist, err) -> {
4530        if (err != null) {
4531          future.completeExceptionally(err);
4532          return;
4533        }
4534        if (!exist) {
4535          future.completeExceptionally(new TableNotFoundException(tableName));
4536          return;
4537        }
4538      });
4539    }
4540    addListener(listTableDescriptors(new ArrayList<>(tables)), (tableDescriptions, err) -> {
4541      if (err != null) {
4542        future.completeExceptionally(err);
4543        return;
4544      }
4545      if (tableDescriptions == null || tableDescriptions.isEmpty()) {
4546        future.complete(null);
4547        return;
4548      }
4549      List<TableDescriptor> newTableDescriptors = new ArrayList<>();
4550      for (TableDescriptor td : tableDescriptions) {
4551        newTableDescriptors
4552          .add(TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(td).setRegionServerGroup(groupName).build());
4553      }
4554      addListener(
4555        CompletableFuture.allOf(
4556          newTableDescriptors.stream().map(this::modifyTable).toArray(CompletableFuture[]::new)),
4557        (v, e) -> {
4558          if (e != null) {
4559            future.completeExceptionally(e);
4560          } else {
4561            future.complete(v);
4562          }
4563        });
4564    });
4565    return future;
4566  }

4633  @Override
4634  public CompletableFuture<List<LogEntry>> getLogEntries(Set<ServerName> serverNames,
4635    String logType, ServerType serverType, int limit, Map<String, Object> filterParams) {
4636    if (logType == null || serverType == null) {
4637      throw new IllegalArgumentException("logType and/or serverType cannot be empty");
4638    }
4639    switch (logType) {
4640      case "SLOW_LOG":
4641      case "LARGE_LOG":
4642        if (ServerType.MASTER.equals(serverType)) {
4643          throw new IllegalArgumentException("Slow/Large logs are not maintained by HMaster");
4644        }
4645        return getSlowLogResponses(filterParams, serverNames, limit, logType);
4646      case "BALANCER_DECISION":
4647        if (ServerType.REGION_SERVER.equals(serverType)) {
4648          throw new IllegalArgumentException(
4649            "Balancer Decision logs are not maintained by HRegionServer");
4650        }
4651        return getBalancerDecisions(limit);
4652      case "BALANCER_REJECTION":
4653        if (ServerType.REGION_SERVER.equals(serverType)) {
4654          throw new IllegalArgumentException(
4655            "Balancer Rejection logs are not maintained by HRegionServer");
4656        }
4657        return getBalancerRejections(limit);
4658      default:
4659        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(Collections.emptyList());
4660    }
4661  }
